paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn lam a, lunggulhtak a, atup tengteng ahih khit vek nung in,
heading: Solomon Kiang Ah Pathian Akilak Nawn / (2 Kro 7.11-22)
english: When Solomon had finished the building of Yahweh’s house, the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,

paite: Gibeon khua a, akiang a, akilak bang in TOUPA Solomon kiang ah ahong kilak nawn hi.
english: Yahweh appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Na thumna leh na ngetna ka ma a na hon tutte ka na ngaikhia hi. Na inn lam tangtawn a ka min omna ding in ka hihsiangthouta hi. Ka mit leh ka lungtang huai ah tangtawn in a-omta ding hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “I have heard your prayer and your supplication that you have made before me. I have made this house holy, which you have built, to put my name there forever; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

paite: Nang leng thu ka hon piak peuhmah bang a hih dia na pa David a om bang, lungtang hoihtak pu leh lungsim diktak pu a ka mitmuh a na om a, ka dan thusehte leh ka vaihawmte na zuih gigeleh,
english: As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, in integrity of heart and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,

paite: Israelte tung ah na gam laltutphah tangtawn a ding in ka hihkip ding; na pa David kiang a, Israelte laltutphah a tu ding na tatlak kei ding, chi a ka na chiamsa bang in.
english: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I promised to David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man on the throne of Israel.’

paite: Himahleh nang hiam na suante hiam in na hon zuih uh kiksan a, ka thupiakte leh ka dan thusehte leh ka hon theihsakte pom lou a, pathian dangte nna na sep ua, na biak uleh,
english: But if you turn away from following me, you or your children, and not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,

paite: gam ka piak a pan Israelte ka hihmang dia; hiai inn ka min a dia ka hihsiangthousa ka mitmuh phak louh ah ka suanmang ding. Huchi in namte lak ah enghouna leh aselam gentehna in Israel zat ahong hi ding.
english: then I will cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and I will cast this house, which I have made holy for my name, out of my sight; and Israel will be a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

paite: Hiai inn sang tawkleh leng, akiang a pai peuhmah in lamdang sa in amuk uh ahum ding ua, bangziak a TOUPA'N hiai gam leh hiai inn hichi tel a hih adiam aw? achi ding uh.
english: Though this house is so high, yet everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss; and they will say, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this land and to this house?’

paite: Mite'n TOUPA a Pathian uh, apute uh Aigupta gam a pan pikhepa apaisan ua, pathian dangte alet ua, abiak ua, a-nnate uh asep ziak uh ahi. Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hiai siatna tengteng atung uah atungsakta hi, chi in adawng ding uh," achi hi.
english: and they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned Yahweh their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and embraced other gods, and worshiped them, and served them. Therefore Yahweh has brought all this evil on them.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon inn nihte; TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn alam sung kum sawmnih abei nung in,
heading: Solomon Leh Hiram Kithukimna / (2 Kro 8.1,2)
english: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, Yahweh’s house and the king’s house

paite: Tura kumpipa Hiram in Solomon sidar singte, meilah singte leh dangka-engte akul teng atupsak vek ahi, kumpipa Solomon in Galili gam a khua sawmnih Hiram apia hi.
english: (now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and cypress trees, and with gold, according to all his desire), King Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

paite: Solomon in apiak khuate en ding in Tura a pan Hiram apawtkhia a; ava en a himahleh alungtung kei.
english: Hiram came out of Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they didn’t please him.

paite: Ama'n, unaupa aw, hiai na hon kho piakte bangchibang khua amaizen ua? achi hi. Huchi in tuni tan in ama'n huai khuate Kabul gam achi hi.
english: He said, “What cities are these which you have given me, my brother?” He called them the land of Cabul to this day.

paite: Hiram in dangka-eng talent za-le-sawmnih kumpipa akhak hi.
english: Hiram sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in phutluih nasem pawl abawl nangawn hiai ahi: TOUPA' inn leh amah inn lam ding leh Millo, Jerusalem kulh, Hazor khua, Meggiddo khua leh Gezer khuate bawl ding in ahi.
heading: Solomon Sepkhiak Dangte / (2 Kro 8.3-18)
english: This is the reason of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted: to build Yahweh’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s wall, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

paite: Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh ahohtou a, Gezer khua ava la a, ahal a, huai khua a teng Kanaante athat a, atanu Solomon zi thilpiak in ana pe khinta ngal a.
english: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, taken Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it for a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

paite: Solomon in Gezer, Beth-horon khangnungzaw,
english: Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower,

paite: Baalath leh Israel gamdai a Tadmor khuate,
english: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness,

paite: Solomon in thil koihkhawmna khua aneih tengteng, akangtalai koihna khuate, Jerusalem khua leh Lebanon a vaihawmna gamsung pumpi Solomon in lunggulhtak a bawl atup tengteng abawl hi.
english: all the storage cities that Solomon had, the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

paite: Israel suante hilou, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte leh Jebus omsun tengtengte;
english: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel—

paite: asuan uh, huai gam a om lai Israel suante'n ahihman zoh vek theihlouhte lak ah Solomon in sikha, phutluih nasem pawl abawl a, tuni tan in asem lai uhi.
english: their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy—of them Solomon raised a levy of bondservants to this day.

paite: Israel suante bel Solomon in sikha in abawl kei. Galdou mite, a-intekpate, amiliante, asepaih heutute, akangtalai leh asakol tungtuang pawl heutute ahi zaw uh.
english: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no bondservants; but they were the men of war, his servants, his princes, his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

paite: Hiaite Solomon nasep tung a heutu tuam, zanga-le-sawmnga, nasep veng mite ahi uh.
english: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon’s work, who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

paite: Himahleh Pharaoh tanu bel David khopi a pan, Solomon in alamsak ama inn ah apaitou hi. Huchi in Solomon in Millo abawl hi.
english: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA a dia abawl maitam ah kum teng in thumvei halmang thillat leh kilemna thillat alan a, TOUPA ma a maitam ah gimlimte ahal hi. Huchi in inn alamzouta hi.
english: Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he built to Yahweh three times per year, burning incense with them on the altar that was before Yahweh. So he finished the house.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in Edom gam a Tuipi San gei Eloth chin a om Ezion-geber mun ah longhon abawl hi.
english: King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.

paite: Hiram in asikha long mite, tuipi a kiseksa, long a Solomon sikhate kiang ah asawl hi.
english: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

paite: Huai mite Ophir ah ava hoh ua, dangka-eng talent zali-le-sawmnih ahon pua ua, kumpipa Solomon kiang hon tun uhi.
english: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to King Solomon.
